sample_boundary: One un-warmed sample performs every requested Context create, first-work action, and Context destroy in process order. Phase timers exclude only the adjacent telemetry reads; the fresh-process wall/CPU counters retain that instrumentation cost.

scenarios.work: No source or module evaluation after full Context and builtin installation.
First script parse, compile, and evaluation of the frozen expression 21 + 21.
First dependency-free module parse, link, and evaluation followed by one global checksum read.
Full WebAssembly feature configuration plus first class, typed-array, JSON, and RegExp script evaluation; Thread, Worker, Promise, and queue work are outside this profile.

context_options_profiles.gc_default: enable_gc=true; enable_jit=true; public default WebAssembly feature set; no threads
context_options_profiles.gc_full_wasm: enable_gc=true; enable_jit=true; every dependency-valid WebAssembly feature flag enabled; no threads

publication_guards: exact first-parent revisions and clean tracked zig-js, zig-gc, and zig-regex worktrees
alternating parent/candidate order with no discarded samples
exact scenario, options profile, iteration count, checksum, runner, and source identities
same-domain task_vm_info current and peak RSS on the declared macOS reference host
measured wall, CPU, instructions, cycles, energy, power, and nominal thermal state
no competing build, test, corpus, or benchmark process before or after an invocation
